d:
Adventurer Mia gets lost in the forest and finds a wounded Slime. Not being able to help, she does the only thing she can and puts her to it's eternal slumber.
Unknown to Mia however, she actually does what she wanted to. And in return, she gains the blessing of the Slime.

Hey there,

Thank you for reading my comic!

I know it's a bit shorter than my usual ones, however originally this was supposed to be a single short comic, but now extended into a small series.

Part 2 is already out on my Website and on my Patreon if you'd like to check it out!
A shorty synopsis for Part 2:

After mercifully laying a slime girl to rest, Mia becomes one with her in body and souls.
With unfamiliar powers and a voice in her mind, she must decide: return to normal… or embrace the adventure of it.

A whole new world opens up around her with the help of her new body.
Corrupted slimes await salvation… and each encounter draws her deeper into sensations she doesn’t fully understand yet.

Of course, carrying such a burden doesn't mean she can't enjoy it along the way no?
